import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    r = s[::-1]

    t = r + "#" + s
    pi = [0] * len(t)

    for i in range(1, len(t)):
        j = pi[i - 1]
        while j > 0 and t[i] != t[j]:
            j = pi[j - 1]
        if t[i] == t[j]:
            j += 1
        pi[i] = j

    longest_pal_suffix = pi[-1]
    ans = s + s[:len(s) - longest_pal_suffix][::-1]
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
